About

Academic direction

I am a textile print designer whose main interest is the design side of printing, with working knowledge of the technology behind printing, dyeing and finishing. I aim to join the academic staff and pass practical experience on to students.

Education

  • B.Sc. in Applied Arts, Textile Printing, Dyeing & Finishing, Beni-Suef University. Very Good, GPA 2.84, 3rd in class.
  • Preparatory Year: Very Good.
  • Graduation project catalogue, academic year 2023/2024.

Graduation Project

Two collections: African Heritage, drawn from African art, and Floral Nature, drawn from flowers. Each print is paired with a matching background so the pattern and its setting read as one identity. Every design has alternative colourways and a colour palette. Photos show the garments I produced.

Heritage Faces

African Heritage collection

Faces, sun motifs and woven-style geometry layered in black, gold, teal and red, made into a vest and wide-leg trousers.

Sublimation printingInspiration: African art

Tribal Geometry

African Heritage collection

Geometric tribal symbols over a watercolour wash, in a bright, layered palette. Applied to a high-neck dress with balloon sleeves.

Sublimation printingInspiration: African patterns

Mauve Garden

Floral Nature collection

A soft watercolour floral in mauve, dusty pink and sage, with the background merged into the flower layers for depth. Shown here in its blue colourway on pleated chiffon.

Sublimation printingInspiration: flowersColourway: blue

Purple Peonies

Floral Nature collection

Large peonies in violet, lilac and teal, with alternative pink and green colourways. Made into a pleated shirt and trouser set.

Sublimation printingInspiration: flowers

Wild Border Garden

Floral Nature collection

A placed floral border with trailing branches and a faded botanical ground, built so the flowers fall at the bodice, waist and hem of a pleated dress and kimono.

Sublimation printingInspiration: botanical borders
